create_SpeechT5Processor: create a SpeechT5Processor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer
process_audio_input: process audio input with SpeechT5Processor and return extracted features
process_text_input: process text input with SpeechT5Processor and return tokenized input ids
pad_batch_inputs: pad a batch of audio input_values or text input_ids with SpeechT5Processor
process_audio_with_labels: process audio input and audio target to produce inputs with labels and decoder attention mask
